packageRules.description: The nightly is pinned on purpose (newer ones break std for espidf); bump it by hand after testing.
libc > 0.2.186 renames the espidf stat fields (st_ctime -> st_ctim) and breaks rustix 0.38; held in Cargo.lock until rustix catches up.
Matter / ESP-IDF crates move together; review them as one PR. Never automerge: CI only builds, and 0.x minor bumps can break pairing on the device.
